name: Activity Discovery
description: A random activity idea with practical details and a manual refresh.
template:
<Stack gap="sm">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center" wrap="nowrap">
    <Text fw={700} size="sm">A little inspiration</Text>
    <RefreshButton requestId="activity" label="Another idea" />
  </Group>
  {status.activity?.loading ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Finding an activity…</Text> : status.activity?.error ? <Text size="sm" c="red">Could not load an activity.</Text> : data.activity ? <Stack gap="xs">
    <Text fw={700} size="lg">{data.activity.activity ?? "Untitled activity"}</Text>
    <Group gap="xs" wrap="wrap">
      <Badge color="blue">{data.activity.type ?? "Activity"}</Badge>
      <Badge color="gray">{data.activity.participants ?? "?"} {data.activity.participants === 1 ? "person" : "people"}</Badge>
      <Badge color="green">Kid-friendly: {data.activity.kidFriendly ? "Yes" : "No"}</Badge>
    </Group>
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Text size="sm">Price score: {data.activity.price ?? "Not listed"} / 1 · Accessibility: {data.activity.accessibility ?? "Not listed"}</Text>
      <Text size="sm">Time: {data.activity.duration ?? "Not listed"} · Availability: {data.activity.availability == null ? "Not listed" : Math.round(data.activity.availability * 100) + "%"}</Text>
    </Stack>
    {data.activity.link ? <Anchor href={data.activity.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" size="sm" lineClamp={1}>Open activity details</Anchor> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No activity link available</Text>}
  </Stack> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No activity suggestion yet.</Text>}
</Stack>
